title: 2018 AMC 10B 13
statement: How many of the first \(2018\) numbers in the sequence \(101,\) \(1001,\) \(10001,\) \(100001,\) \(\ldots\) are divisible by \(101?\)

solutions.text: The \(k\)-th term is \(10^{k+1} + 1,\) which \(101\) divides iff \(10^{k+1} \equiv -1 \pmod{101}.\) Notice \(10^2 = 100 \equiv -1 \pmod{101}.\) So \(10^m \equiv -1\) exactly when \(m \equiv 2 \pmod 4,\) meaning \(k + 1 \equiv 2,\) that is \(k \equiv 1 \pmod 4.\) Among \(k = 1, 2, \ldots, 2018,\) the values \(1, 5, \ldots, 2017\) number \(505.\) Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The \(k\)-th term is \(10^{k+1} + 1,\) which is divisible by \(101\) when \(10^{k+1} \equiv -1 \pmod{101}\)
